name: Gauge Chart
description: Semicircle SVG gauge with min/max scale, threshold zones, and a centered value label.
usage:
<GaugeChart
  aria-label="Latency score"
  value={64}
  label="Latency score"
  thresholds={[{ upTo: 50 }, { upTo: 80 }, { upTo: 100 }]}
/>

anatomy.description: Semicircular arc showing the full min–max scale, split into threshold zones when provided.
Filled arc clamped to the scale and colored by the active threshold zone.
Min and max values printed at the arc ends.
Raw value and optional caption centered beneath the arc.

dos: Label threshold zones so the accessible summary can name them.
Keep the scale honest: min and max should bound the realistic values.
Pair with a Stat when the exact number matters more than the zone.
donts: Don't compare several KPIs with a row of gauges; use BarChart or a Stat list.
Don't exceed three or four zones; more become indistinguishable along the arc.
Don't rely on zone color alone for status; the caption should carry the meaning.

examples.title: Threshold zones
examples.description: Value arc colored by the active zone, with the zones drawn along the track.

examples.title: Plain and custom scales
examples.description: A zoneless gauge plus a gauge with a custom min/max range.

guidance.useWhen: You need a single KPI against a known scale with qualitative zones, such as latency scores or capacity.
guidance.avoidWhen: You compare several values or trends; use Stat, Meter, or Sparkline instead.
guidance.behavior: Purely presentational: the value arc clamps to the min–max range while the center text always shows the raw value.
guidance.responsive: Renders at the given width and height; shrink width at narrow viewports since the radius derives from it.

notes: The gauge is a single role="img" with an aria-label; a visually hidden summary states the value, range, and zones.
The numeric value and label are real text, so the reading never depends on arc length or color alone.

props.description: Accessible description of the gauge, applied as aria-label.
props.name: aria-label

props.description: Current value; the arc is clamped to the min–max range.
props.name: value

props.description: Threshold zones drawn along the arc.
props.name: thresholds

props.description: Caption rendered under the center value.
